styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: bright high-key American kitchen e-commerce for a mini electric egg cooker. Every shot sits on a white marble counter #EDEDEA to #F4F4F2 or seamless studio white #FFFFFF, backed by soft white subway tile, with organic curved color blocks in mint #CBE5DC and #DDEBE6, butter #F7EBC3 and blush #F9DFD8 hosting all copy so text never crowds the product. Lighting is always top softbox, soft and even, with faint contact shadows and a fresh food-editorial feel; only the dishwasher trust shot may run neutral-cool stainless. The appliance keeps its exact silhouette - clear dome lid, three-footed glossy base in black #1E1E1E or pastel variants, a single silver button and a lit indicator - always shown powered on with eggs loaded. Rounded geometric all-caps red #E2231A headlines, dark green #1F3B36 body, red handwritten accents; infographics use vertical scale bars, circular yolk icons graded #F0A32E to #F5D77A, thin 1px red leader lines and hand-drawn doodles. One USP per frame; strip all brand marks, never show other-brand appliances, never fabricate awards or minute-level timing data.
